'''Cauchy''' is a NPC male professor with impressive memory for students actually enrolled in class. He can be found in the Exostrider Engineering classroom during the afternoon. 

'''Gabriel''', a student from the Department of Light Energy, is caught sitting in for another student.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
;(From another professor)
:Your Physical Conditioning teacher is out sick today, so we're doing Neuroresonance Topology instead.
:({{tt|Walla|A sound effect imitating the murmur of a crowd in the background}}: Students groaning in disappointment.){{sic}}

;(From another professor)
:"The biological characteristics of the Exostrider and Exoswarms show they are nothing like ordinary machines."
:"They  don't run on any programming. They can learn, adapt, and produce results we never predicted."
:"They also display a certain degree of self awareness..."
:No sleeping in class!

==Dialogue==
:'''Cauchy:''' We have five out of twenty-five students here today.
:'''Cauchy:''' No need to check attendance. Any student not here will be marked absent.
:'''Cauchy:''' Are you here to sit in? Please sit somewhere in the back.
:{{DIcon}} Sir, aren't there a lot more than just five students present?
:'''Cauchy:''' If you are not a person enrolled in this course, you are absent.
:'''Cauchy:''' And while we're at it, let's have a quiz at the end of today's lecture.
:'''Cauchy:''' It will count towards 30% of your final grade this semester.
----
:'''Gabriel:''' Ugh, what is this professor? How does he remember every single student's face?
:'''Gabriel:''' I didn't have any issues standing in for other classes. This is the only one where I got caught.
:{{DIcon}} Oh. You're standing in for another student?
:'''Gabriel:''' Yeah, and now I'm screwed.
:'''Gabriel:''' I've never taken any Material Science courses before... I'm from the Agronomy Wing.
:'''Gabriel:''' I need to find the guy who's supposed to be here. If there's a quiz coming, I'm not facing a test I know nothing about...
{{Dialogue End}}
